# env/components-creds.example.txt — infra-creds template for 15-api-gateway (### NN_Service format).
#
# REAL secrets go in env/components-creds.txt (GITIGNORED) — never in this committed
# .example file. Workflow:
#   cp env/components-creds.example.txt env/components-creds.txt
#   $EDITOR env/components-creds.txt        # paste your REAL infra creds (the full ### dump)
#   chmod 600 env/components-creds.txt
#   ./env/init-env.sh .env.dev             # renders env/.env.dev
#
# init-env.sh reads env/components-creds.txt (gitignored). Paste your FULL infra status
# dump (all ### blocks); 15-api-gateway uses only these:
#   02_MongoDB 04_Redis 07_Elastic_APM.
# The gateway is STATELESS (no PostgreSQL / Kafka / RabbitMQ) — Redis DB13 is its only
# datastore (the token-bucket rate-limiter). Other blocks are ignored — including
# 03_Elasticsearch (:9201), the search/review business ES used ONLY by 05-search + 08-review.
#
# VERIFY-ONLY: 15-api-gateway verifies auth's JWTs with auth's PUBLIC key + the shared
# INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN — it NEVER holds a private key. Paste those into the
# ### Auth_Identity block below (from 01-auth's rendered .env.dev). If that block is
# left as a placeholder, init-env.sh falls back to auto-discovering the deployed
# 01-auth's .env.dev (AUTH_ENV_FILE, default /opt/dokandar/01-auth/env/.env.dev).

### 02_MongoDB
   endpoint       mongodb://<user>:<password>@<host>:27017/?authSource=admin
   host:port      <host>:27017
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 04_Redis
   endpoint       redis://default:<password>@<host>:6379/0
   host:port      <host>:6379
   user           default
   password       <password>

# --- 07's `elasticsearch` line is the APM-stack ES (:9200) — the application LOG SINK. ---
### 07_Elastic_APM
   elasticsearch  http://elastic:<apm-es-password>@<host>:9200
   apm-ingest     http://<host>:8200  (Bearer token)
   apm-token      <apm-bearer-token>
   kibana-ui      http://<host>:5601  (login: elastic)
   elastic-pass   <apm-es-password>

# --- Auth_Identity — auth's PUBLIC key + shared east-west token (verify-only). ---
# Paste from 01-auth's rendered .env.dev (JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64 / INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN).
# NEVER a private key. Leave as <placeholders> to use the AUTH_ENV_FILE fallback.
### Auth_Identity
   auth_service_public_key   <paste 01-auth .env.dev JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64>
   internal_service_token    <paste 01-auth .env.dev INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN>
